annotations.title: Get the deposit link for a fixed quote

description: For a client who already has a fixed quote from Nikita (it has a number like Q-12). Give the quote number and the email it was sent to, exactly as in Nikita's email. Returns the quote and a Stripe payment link for its 50% deposit; the balance is due when the project is finished. It doesn't pay or accept anything: the user opens the link and pays there themselves, and card details go only to Stripe. The project is booked once the payment goes through. The deposit is fully refundable until the user and Nikita reach the final agreement on a call or at a meeting, and if VIDEO DEPT. can't do the date, the user gets all of it back.

email.description: The email address the quote was sent to, exactly as in Nikita's email.

quote.description: The quote number exactly as in Nikita's email, e.g. "Q-12".
